Passages:
[1] [GitLab PTY Ltd. Benefits - New Zealand > **GitLab PTY Ltd. Benefits - New Zealand** > **Time Away & Leave Policies** > **Annual Leave**]
Annual leave giving you flexibility to plan time off while ensuring work-life balance.

Leave Entitlement & Key Details

**Your Entitlement:**

- **Minimum:** 4 weeks annual leave per year
- **Carry over:** Annual leave does not expire and can be accumulated
- **Management expectations:** GitLab may set reasonable expectations about leave accumulation and may require leave with 14 days notice

**How to Use:**

- Runs concurrently with GitLab's Flexible PTO policy
- Select "Paid Time Off" in Workday to ensure proper statutory tracking
- Plan time off that works for both you and your work commitments

[2] [GitLab Singapore Pte Ltd > We've Got You Covered > Time off Policies > Annual Leave]
- Holiday allowance: Holiday allowance: After 3 months of employment, accrual rates will be based on tenure. Team members are allowed to carry over unused vacation up to the statutory accrual limit based on tenure.
  - 1 year of service: 7 days/year
  - 2 years of service: 8 days/year
  - 3 years of service: 9 days/year
  - 4 years of service: 10 days/year
  - 5 years of service: 11 days/year
  - 6 years of service: 12 days/year
  - 7 years of service: 13 days/year
  - 8 years of service: 14 days/year
  
- Runs concurrently with GitLab PTO
- Enter time off in Workday using "Paid Time Off" option
- Coordinate with your team to ensure coverage
- Unused leave requires approval to carry forward

[3] [GitLab PTY Ltd. Benefits - New Zealand > **GitLab PTY Ltd. Benefits - New Zealand** > **Time Away & Leave Policies** > **Statutory Sick Leave**]
Comprehensive sick leave coverage that builds over time, supporting you during illness while running alongside GitLab's additional sick time support.

Leave Entitlement & Key Details

**Sick Leave Entitlement:**

- **Eligibility:** 10 days statutory sick leave after 6 months continuous employment
- **Annual entitlement:** 10 days per 12-month period after meeting initial criteria
- **Carry over:** If in any year the team member doesn't meet the criteria, then they don't get any new sick leave entitlement, but can use their sick leave balance which may have carried over. An employee may re-qualify for sick leave as soon as they meet the criteria.
- **Maximum accumulation:** 20 days under New Zealand's Holidays Act 2003
- **Additional Support:** Runs concurrently with [GitLab's Sick Time Policy](/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#sick-time)

**How to Apply:**

1. Contact leaves@gitlab.com when taking sick leave
2. Medical certificate may be required per Holidays Act
3. Select "Out Sick" in Workday for proper tracking
4. Unused sick leave is not paid out upon employment termination

[4] [GitLab PTY Ltd. Benefits - New Zealand > **GitLab PTY Ltd. Benefits - New Zealand** > **Time Away & Leave Policies** > **Additional Leave Types**]
Leave without pay is when GitLab allows an team member time off work when they would otherwise be working, but doesn't pay them for this time. Leave without pay (LWOP) doesn't end an team member's employment, and usually the team member returns to their same position and terms and conditions after taking leave without pay (unless the employee and team member agree otherwise). Leave without pay can affect the employee's annual holidays payment and entitlement in some situations.

- Team members must designate this time off as `Out Sick` in Workday.

For more information regarding Leave without Pay, please review the [Employment New Zealand's website](https://www.employment.govt.nz/leave-and-holidays/other-types-of-leave/leave-without-pay).

Long Service Leave

While not a legal requirement, long service leave may be negotiated between a team member and GitLab as additional entitlements under their employment agreement.

- This leave runs concurrently with GitLab PTO. Team members must designate this time off as `Paid Time Off` in Workday.

Question: If an employee moves from GitLab PTY Ltd. in New Zealand to GitLab Singapore Pte Ltd., how does the annual leave entitlement change and what is required to carry over unused leave in each location?

Answer:
In New Zealand, the minimum annual leave entitlement is 4 weeks per year, which does not expire and can be accumulated [1]. In Singapore, the entitlement starts at 7 days per year after 3 months of employment and increases with tenure up to 14 days, with unused leave requiring approval to carry forward up to the statutory limit [2].
